# OpenCC character dictionaries

Source: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/tree/master/data/dictionary

`core/src/main/resources/opencc/TSCharacters.txt` and `STCharacters.txt` are OpenCC character dictionaries, copyright the OpenCC contributors, licensed under Apache-2.0. A copy of the license is in this directory and packaged with the dictionaries.

NYQOVA uses character keys for Chinese search matching. This is not full phrase-aware conversion, and display metadata is never rewritten by it.
